not_configured: The assistant is not configured in the integration options.
plan_shape: Plan must be an object with 'levels'
outdoor_overlap: Outdoor area “{outside}” lies under “{room}” ({area:.1f} m²) — trim the outdoor area to the wall
room_gap: There is a {gap:.2f} m gap between “{first}” and “{second}” — place the shared wall on exactly the same line
room_too_small_shape: Room is too small or has fewer than 3 corners
overlap_hint: . Place the shared wall exactly on the edge of the neighbouring room.
model_connection: Timeout or connection error while contacting the model: {error}
endpoint_unreadable: Could not read the endpoint response
model_no_json: The model did not return JSON. Use a model with vision support.
model_invalid_json: The model response is not valid JSON ({error}). Please try again.
rooms_unusable: The model returned {count} rooms, but none could be used ({reason}). Use “Copy model answer” and report it, or try another model.
rooms_none: The model did not return any rooms. Try again, add hints, or use another model with image support.
dimensions_missing: No readable dimension chains were found in the plan. Measure a distance in the Scale step.
dimension_mismatch: “{room}”: the {wanted:.2f} m plan dimension does not match the drawing ({actual:.2f} m) — please check it
dimension_conflict: Plan dimensions across the {axis} conflict — rooms were not adjusted; please check them
dimensions_applied: Applied {count} room dimension(s) across the {axis} from the plan
neighbour_dimension_conflict: “{room}”: plan dimensions conflict with neighbouring rooms (difference {error:.2f} m) — please check them
detect_timeout: Timeout: the model did not finish within 5 minutes. Try again or choose a faster model / turn reasoning off.
image_type: Only JPEG or PNG images are supported
